title: Spell Shop by the Stormy Sea
description: A surreal night scene shows a wooden Spell Shop with a purple sign reading 'LOCKED DURING 5 STARS HAIL PATH CLOSED'. In the foreground, four hooded figures in purple headscarves stand in a row; one holds a glowing green potion, another reads an open book. Behind the shop, turbulent blue-green waves crash against a pier with a 'TRASH PICKER' sign, while two large wind chimes float in a dark, smoky sky filled with purple ghosts and bats.
